title: Vibe Logisim canonical model view v1
description: A model-only view of known producer responses; no per-response projection metadata or decoder is added. Original schema and unknown fields remain. A declared legacy metadata field may be omitted only if its non-null value exactly equals the complete value at its canonical location. Conflicts and unknown values stay. This is semantic deduplication, not a codec to reconstruct the old UI object field-presence pattern. Rules below are build-time documentation and test constraints, never model output.

binding.description: Complete canonical project/revision/artifact/circuit/candidate and runtime profile identity; not pruned.

run.description: Canonical run ID, authority, stimulus and mode where the producer supplies a run envelope. Its duplicate runtimeProfileId can be omitted in favor of binding.runtimeProfileId.

result.description: Domain observation when an envelope exists. Rows, bits, execution identity, inputs and failures are unchanged. Flat trace responses retain their observation fields at the root; this view does not fabricate an envelope.

objectReferenceTemplate.description: Existing inspect template; substitute the verified componentId for COMPONENT_ID. An explicit component reference, when present, takes precedence, particularly for historical/live instance links.

x-inspect-reference-rule: For inspect_circuit with no producer schema: preserve the existing template, IDs and component order. Only omit a string components[i].reference exactly equal to the existing circuit://object? template after substituting its sole COMPONENT_ID in the componentId query parameter. IDs must use URI-unreserved ASCII characters. Any differing, null, missing or ambiguous reference stays verbatim, including a reference with a different instance scope. All other electrical facts are unchanged.
x-host-state-preserved: workspace.currentRevisionId, workspace.savedRevisionId and sourceStatus.currentSha256 retain their own meanings as current, saved and on-disk state. All remain explicit even when equal to revision.id or revision.artifactSha256.
